en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a formal procession of well‑dressed men in top hats and long overcoats walking in front of a grand baroque‑style building. One man at the right wears a sash, suggesting an official or ceremonial role. The background façade features large arched doors, decorative columns, and an ornate sculpted coat of arms or emblem above the entrance. The scene appears to be an early‑20th‑century civic or diplomatic event in front of a major governmental or royal building.
